statements: importOrders and importRefunds in src/import.mjs are nearly the same. Extract what they share into importRows(rows, options) in src/rows.mjs, which both call, so a third import is short.
Then add importCredits(rows) to src/import.mjs. It treats a row the way importRefunds does, except that a row whose amount is zero or negative is skipped.
Everything importOrders and importRefunds return today stays exactly the same.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Unify the two import functions and add importCredits, as the numbered statements describe. Nothing about the existing imports may change. Follow the conventions already in the code.
